$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFLU (AIP France, chart dated 2024-11-28): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Valence-Chabeuil

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

service.atsHours: AFIS : Sauf JF / Except public HOL. LUN - VEN / MON - FRI : 0700 -1800. En dehors de ces HOR et pour les vols commerciaux seulement : PPR PN 24 HR auprès de l'exploitant d'aérodrome et avant VEN 1300 pour les SAM et DIM. notes: Aerodrome reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of paved RWY and grass strip 01L/19R prohibited.
Simultaneous use of grass strips prohibited.
Grass strip 01R/19L reserved only for gliders landing and home-based helicopters training in accordance with local instructions.
External ULM: during ATS SKED, contact TWR by phone before flight.
MIL ACFT departing to GAMSTAT: PPR PN 24HR on 04 75 79 76 41.
TORA and TODA RWY 19 reduced by 90 m due to the presence of the road clearance in take-off funnel 19.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Aerodrome circuits: ACFT on the East of the Bérards.
For ACFT over 30 t, runway turnaround areas compulsory.
TWY parallel to RWY, available for light ACFT.
Access to GAMSTAT apron:.
Gate N: width 23.4 m.
Gate M: width 23.5 m.
Internal gate: width 23 m.

Low height circuits: authorized for training with an instructor only (eastern circuit).
Only one low height circuit possible per period of 15 minutes.
Outside ATS SKED, one low height circuit possible per period of 30 minutes, until 2200 local time.
Low height circuit prohibited without instructor, below 500 ft ASFC, or after 2200 local time, or on Sunday.
Landing RWY 19: PAPI compulsory, by day for jet ACFT or commercial transport ACFT, by night for all ACFT.
TWY L, M, N and S available during daytime only and for RVR 800 m.

If pelicandrome active, TWY S closed.

ARR: last route segment altitude will be used until field in sight in the 5 NM AD area to join the traffic pattern.
Outside ATS SKED: When operating PCL, local flight activity is restricted at two ACFT in the circuit until 2230 local time.
Outside this period for ARR and DEP only (journeys).
STAP: available data: wind, cloud base, instrumental visibility, T, DP, QNH, QFE.
PAPI not turned on by PCL.
